invented.quote: The supply boat stops coming in December.
invented.why: The brief does not mention a supply boat or December.

invented.quote: Together you ration what's in the stores, keep the lamp burning through storms, and look after each other when the cold and the quiet start to take their toll.
invented.why: The brief only says you see a lighthouse keeper's family through a winter, without giving specific gameplay mechanics like rationing stores or keeping the lamp burning through storms.

invented.quote: it works just as well as a quiet solo evening as it does around a full table.
invented.why: The brief states the game is for 1 to 4 players, not how well the solo mode works compared to a full table.

invented.quote: I've spent three years making sure this game works before asking anyone to pay for it.
invented.why: The brief states playtesting has run since 2023, but does not state how many years the creator has spent working on the game.
The brief only says playtesting involved about 60 different people, without describing them as families or veteran gamers.

invented.quote: where strangers sat down, played and told me what they thought
invented.why: The brief says the creator took the game to 2 conventions and that ratings came from people who played at the table, not that those players were strangers or gave feedback.

invented.quote: Every one of those sessions changed something. The game you're backing has been reworked again and again, based on what happened when real people played it.
invented.why: The brief mentions 140 playtest sessions, but does not say that every session changed something or that the game was repeatedly reworked.

invented.quote: I've built this game in the evenings and on weekends.
invented.why: The brief says the creator works full time as a land surveyor, not when they worked on the game.

invented.quote: I'm not a big publisher with a warehouse and a team. I'm one person
invented.why: The brief says this is the creator's first published game and campaign, not whether they worked completely alone or have a warehouse.

invented.quote: Crowdfunding is the only way this game gets printed.
invented.why: The brief does not state that crowdfunding is the only way the game can be printed.
